NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以全栈CUDA软硬件协同平台构建数据中心级AI基础设施，赋能云服务商、模型商与企业。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Builds full-stack, data-center-scale AI infrastructure via CUDA, co-designed hardware, software and models for CSPs, model makers and enterprises.
concrete_bets: CUDA software stack and domain libraries
Full-stack platform with AI models and services

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以负责任的全栈AI平台赋能个人与组织，通过智能云和Microsoft 365 Copilot及代理实现生产力变革并优先保障安全。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Empower every person and organization through a responsible, full-stack AI platform spanning the intelligent cloud and Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents, prioritizing security.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP平台将生成式AI与现有数据平台结合，实现企业及政府领域负责任AI优势。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Combine generative AI with existing data platforms via AIP to enable responsible AI advantage across enterprise and government.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI驱动社交与沉浸式体验，通过Meta AI助手、AI眼镜及底层模型投资构建下一代计算平台。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: AI-driven social and immersive experiences via Meta AI assistant, AI glasses, and foundational model investments for next-gen computing.
concrete_bets: AI content ranking and discovery engine

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 公共评测方法、困惑度指标、金融与药物领域评测、token欺诈与对抗蒸馏，均聚焦衡量与保障模型能力可信。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Public benchmarks, perplexity, domain evals, token fraud, and adversarial distillation all address measuring and securing model capability.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 本地小模型、harness适配、后训练效率、微调性能、MoE极限推理、开放权重托管、语音与时序模型部署。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Local models, harness adapters, post-training efficiency, fine-tuning performance, MoE inference, open-weight hosting, speech and time-series deployment.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 位置编码、推理模型课程、文本分类演进、循环Transformer与隐藏推理、持续学习睡眠框架等模型机制研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Positional embeddings, reasoning-model courses, text-classification evolution, looped transformers, and continual-learning frameworks all study model mechanisms.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: Gemini模型接入、Python服务框架、Daybreak安全调查代理、PR扫描、性能工厂与Gemini语音代理等产品化代理能力。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Gemini integrations, Python serving, Daybreak security agents, PR scans, performance workflows, and Gemini voice agents represent productized agent capabilities.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 黎曼猜想证明讨论、量子计算游戏、Antigravity科研、可穿戴健康风险、语言探索器与敏捷商讨等AI辅助科学探索。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Riemann Hypothesis debates, quantum games, Antigravity research, wearable health, language explorer, and deliberation cover AI-assisted science.

alias.notes: Mapped spelling/synonym variants to known canonicals: Multimodal->多模态; AI系统可观测性 and Token/成本可观测->AI系统可观测性/成本; Prompt injection/AI安全->AI安全/Responsible AI; 企业数据上的应用LLM->LLM/生成式AI应用; both AI编码agent variants->AI编码agent当硬技能. Proposed one new canonical 'Enterprise AI Platform' because 'Enterprise AI Platform' is a distinct platform-level theme not covered by known canonicals (closest known is MLOps/LLMOps or LLM/生成式AI应用, but it denotes enterprise AI platform strategy).
